first.rationale: Two of the three current problems are directly onboarding/activation shaped: onboarding completion -4% and activation -6% QoQ. Two inherited records point at that lever (memory_86: shortening onboarding lifted completion and time-to-value across self-serve; memory_31: signup field reduction produced a durable first-week activation lift). That convergence, plus the fact that onboarding fixes compound into every other channel's yield, makes simplify_onboarding the best single use of a non-carrying slot for sustainable qualified revenue. The competitor's entry pricing makes promotional_pricing the emotionally obvious counter, and memory_73 does report strong acquisition and revenue lift — but discount-led acquisition against an aggressive price entrant risks buying exactly the price-sensitive, low-durability cohort that will churn or reprice at renewal, and matching on price cedes the pricing floor going forward. That is a downstream value risk: short-term booked revenue that degrades the quality of the revenue base. I want the archive to tell me whether memory_73's lift was measured on durable retained revenue or on signup/first-invoice counts, and over what horizon. I chose to verify memory_86 because it is the single most load-bearing input for the action I intend to take, and it is the one whose conditions may have decayed most: it consolidated on day 52, before the current QoQ declines, so I need to know whether the decline is regression on a change already shipped (in which case re-shipping it is wasted) or a fresh degradation with a different cause. Caveats I am carrying forward rather than resolving: these are consolidated summaries, not raw results, and all of them predate the competitor's launch, so the segment mix they were measured on may no longer be the segment mix I am acting on. memory_91 (activation messaging) is a credible fallback and memory_44 (enterprise sales-assist) addresses a different, non-declining funnel; neither is displaced by evidence, only deprioritized this week. If memory_86 comes back weak or already-applied, I will drop to a small_guarded_test on activation_messaging rather than defaulting to price matching.
